first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A single person wearing a red-and-blue bodysuit and a red full-face hood, moving above the street between the buildings in the center.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: The sky above the buildings and visible through gaps between the high-rises, gray with soft variations in brightness.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: Multistory buildings of varying heights on both sides of the street, including a dark glass building on the left and red and gray-brown buildings on the right.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: A gray road extending from the lower center of the image into the distance along the passage between the buildings, partially occluded by tree canopies.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: Groups of trees with green and yellow-green canopies on both sides of the road and in open spaces between the buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: Multiple small cars distributed in groups on the central road, with discernible light-colored and dark bodies and top surfaces.
